title: Responsable superior de marketing
description:
About the job

We're hiring: Senior Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist — Financial Services | 100% Remote




Arvenda is a staffing company connecting top LATAM talent with U.S.-based clients. We are recruiting a Senior Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist for a specialized financial advisory firm that helps U.S. businesses restructure and recover from Merchant Cash Advance (MCA) debt.




The closing team is strong. What they need now is someone to build and own the pipeline that feeds it.




This is not a role for someone who executes someone else's playbook. We need someone who builds the system, runs it, and delivers warm, qualified opportunities directly to the advisory and legal team — ready for closure.




Schedule: Full-time · 9:00 AM–5:00 PM CST · Slight flexibility for exceptional candidates




The salary is $1,600–$1,800 USD, depending on your experience.




What you'll do




Design and execute a comprehensive B2B outbound prospecting strategy targeting U.S. businesses struggling with MCA debt or in need of financial restructuring




Identify, capture, and organize prospect data to build a highly qualified, active sales pipeline




Conduct multi-channel outreach via cold calling, email, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels




Qualify prospects before passing them to the advisory team — only warm, sales-ready leads reach the closing team




Build, maintain, and optimize prospect records and pipeline stages in Salesforce




Develop and refine outreach messaging, sequences, and scripts that resonate with financially distressed business owners




Monitor pipeline metrics: lead volume, quality, conversion rates, and outreach performance




Proactively identify new prospecting channels and data sources to maximize pipeline throughput




Operate fully independently — build the system, run it, and improve it without daily direction




What we're looking for




4+ years of proven experience in B2B marketing, outbound lead generation, or pipeline management — required




Demonstrated ability to build a lead generation system from scratch — not just execute an existing one




Exceptional English (C1/C2) with a highly neutral, professional accent — you'll speak directly with U.S. business owners in high-stakes financial situations




Advanced Salesforce proficiency — disciplined, consistent CRM management




Strong multi-channel outbound experience: cold calling, email sequencing, LinkedIn prospecting




100% self-starter — proactive, autonomous, results-driven without micromanagement




Strong analytical mindset — you track your own metrics and adjust based on data




Nice to have — significant plus




Prior experience in MCA, alternative lending, debt restructuring, or U.S. financial services




Familiarity with MCA industry language and the profile of business owners who need restructuring




Experience with data sourcing tools (Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator)




Experience with email automation platforms (Outreach, Instantly, Lemlist, or similar)




How to apply

Send your English CV to jerelyn@arvenda.com with the subject line "Sr Lead Gen Specialist – [Your Name]". Applications without an English CV will not be considered.




Learn more about Arvenda: Arvenda LLC on LinkedIn · www.arvenda.com




#LeadGeneration #B2BMarketing #OutboundSales #MCA #FinancialServices #RemoteJobsLATAM #HiringNow #Arvenda

description:
About the job

Wonolo (Work Now Locally) is disrupting the $140BN temporary staffing industry. Founded in 2014, Wonolo's mission is to help people find consistent work. Through our two-sided tech marketplace, we connect hundreds of businesses in need of front-line workers with 2 million underemployed workers in local markets across the United States, within minutes. Wonolo has raised over $200M in funding which will continue to help us empower the in-demand workforce by democratizing access to flexible work, opportunities to learn new skills, a living wage, and comprehensive portable benefits and perks.




We are looking for a Growth Marketing Associate to work with Wonolo’s Marketing team. You will be employed by a third-party legal entity authorized to do business in the location in which you reside and you will provide contractual services to Wonolo’s Marketing team. We're building the B2C acquisition and activation machine that brings workers to Wonolo, helps them succeed on their first job, and keeps them coming back. You'll be the technical builder behind that machine, working alongside the team that leads funnel and lifecycle strategy, translating defined priorities into automations, AI-powered flows, and campaigns that run at scale.




You operate autonomously, with market data as your primary input for deciding where to focus and what to activate. You'll partner closely with the Business Operations team when you need qualitative context on specific customers or market conditions that the data doesn't capture. You'll use that context to prioritize where to activate, what campaign response fits the moment, and how your work contributes to revenue attainment across markets.




The right person thinks like a marketer and builds with low-code and AI tools. You're execution-oriented, detail-driven, and motivated by seeing your work directly move supply-side metrics. Are you excited about working with a close-knit team at a mission-driven, US-based technology company? If this is who you are or you can and desperately want to be, please read on!




We welcome qualified candidates located anywhere in Latin America #LI-Remote.




Who you are:




Campaign Execution

Monitor market health data across active markets independently and activate the right campaign response: new customer launching, customer ramping, low fill rate, supply churn, geographic supply gaps, and similar demand factors
Own campaign prioritization and execution end-to-end: pulling the right audience, selecting the right channel and message, turning campaigns on, and tracking performance through to outcome
Partner with the Business Operations team to gather qualitative intel on specific customers or market conditions that analytical data doesn't capture, and use it to sharpen decisions you're already making
Work from established playbooks while flagging when market conditions call for something outside the standard response
Report campaign performance back to the team with a clear read on what worked and what to adjust




Campaign Automation & Activation

Use your campaign execution work as the foundation for everything you build, leveraging what you learn from running campaigns to inform what you turn into scalable systems.
Map the worker journey from acquisition through activation to understand where friction lives, then build automations and AI-powered flows that remove it
Translate funnel strategy into systems: triggered campaigns, onboarding sequences, re-engagement flows, and the logic that runs them
Build tooling to test and iterate on activation and retention campaigns across markets so the team can move fast without manual effort
Build high-leverage automations that enable fast campaign activation across organic and paid channels, including social, job boards, answer engine optimization, and search




AI-Native Workflows

Identify marketing workflows that are still manual and rebuild them to be AI-native, focusing on where AI can improve speed, personalization, or conversion outcomes
Build AI agent workflows that support acquisition, content, and competitive intelligence, covering prompts, data sources, structured outputs, and the human checkpoints that need to stay in the loop
Build evaluation frameworks that measure agent output quality and tie results back to marketing KPIs
Stay current on new AI tools and revisit existing workflows to incorporate improvements as the technology moves




Who you are:




2 to 3+ years in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, technical marketing, or a role where you owned both strategy and build
You've shipped internal tools that teams fully adopted and used to inflect marketing KPIs
You understand user behavior in a B2C funnel: what good activation looks like, where drop-off happens, and how to design around it
Experience with marketing automation platforms (Iterable, Smartly, or similar); you know how to build and optimize triggered campaigns, not just run them
You can build autonomously using low-code and AI tools; you don't need an engineering ticket to ship
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic), including prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluation loops
Experience building with tools like Zapier, Clay, Framer, or Lovable




If you have read up to this point, we hope you are excited about this opportunity to work at Wonolo! Even if your experience does not check every bullet point, we still highly encourage you to apply. The best hires do not always check off every box of a job description.




Nice to haves:

Benefits and perks:

Company laptop

Team outings, happy hours, company off-sites, and more!




Important Notice Regarding Fraudulent Recruiting




Disclaimer: We only communicate with candidates through official @wonolo.com email addresses.




Employment scammers may impersonate legitimate recruiters, employers, or recruitment firms, using email, text messages, messaging apps (including, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, etc.), or fake social media accounts to contact you. They may advertise roles that do not exist, claim to represent Wonolo, or use our name and branding without authorization.




Wonolo is aware that individuals posing as recruiters have communicated with job seekers about positions with Wonolo that do not exist. We have received reports that the content and method of communication has varied, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive personal information.




Wonolo will never ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information. All open positions are posted in country specific employment portals available at https://info.wonolo.com/careers/. All legitimate job postings on third-party employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application directly through the Wonolo careers page.




Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Wonolo’s recruiting process in general should email recruiting@wonolo.com.

We are a remote-first company with 200+ full-time employees, and quickly scaling our team within the United States, Canada, and Latin America. We are well-funded and backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital, and Leeds Illuminate, among others.

Yong Kim (CEO) on why he's passionate about empowering the in-demand workforce




Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Equity, and Belonging

Wonolo welcomes you as you and celebrates our collective diversity. We work to serve the underserved, and we are built on the strength of our entire community. We know that diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make for the best teams, and help to drive high performance. We strive to ensure that our team represents different cultures, perspectives, and backgrounds, as these empower our team to come together to make the best decisions and the biggest impact.

Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables

description:
About the job

About The Role

Operations at Shopify designs and operates the systems, architecture, and conditions that drive alignment, speed, and execution across the company. We don't run process for process's sake. We build the operating system that lets product, revenue, and talent move at the pace Shopify needs.

We're bringing that operating discipline to Revenue Marketing. Marketing spans multiple teams and reporting lines, and it moves fastest when someone owns the connective tissue — one execution rhythm, one set of priorities, one bar. We're hiring a Senior Lead, Strategy & Operations to be that person: a generalist operator with real marketing instincts who unifies how the work gets planned, sequenced, and shipped, and who takes operational overhead off leaders so the teams can move.

This is an individual contributor role. You won't manage people. You'll set the bar and lead through influence.

What You'll Do


Unify execution across Revenue Marketing. Build the operating rhythm — planning, prioritization, dependency tracking, performance tracking, decision velocity — that lets teams under different leaders execute against a single vision.
Own the operating system for getting campaigns out the door. Navigate the dependencies that make or break a launch — growth, design, brand — and know who to pull in and how to make it happen.
Subtract things that make us slow. Kill processes, automate workflows, rewire bad incentives, spot tooling opportunities. Reduce the operational overhead of running Revenue Marketing. Less is more.
See the whole board. Understand where the marketing teams are spending, what they're accomplishing, and whether they're operating cohesively — and, over time, help run company-wide marketing rituals that raise outcomes across the org.
Get smart about what's working. Bring analytical rigor to measuring marketing outcomes, including the hard ones — event impact, incrementality, attribution — and be honest about where the signal ends.
Use AI as a force multiplier. Not as a productivity layer — as the way the work gets done. Design workflows that eliminate manual work at scale.
Parachute into ambiguity and ramp in days. Take ownership. Escalation ends with you.



What This Isn't


Not a program manager role. We aren't hiring someone to run tickets or chase RAID logs.
Not a chief-of-staff role. You aren't an extension of one leader — you're deployed against the org's problems.
Not a brand or creative vision role. You make marketing execution excellent; you're not here to redefine the brand.
Not a P&L role. Your leverage is influence, alignment, and execution — not owning the number.



What We're Looking For


An operator, not an advisor. You've carried outcomes across cross-functional teams, pulled people together, and made things happen. You've been in the weeds and the most senior person in the room at the same time.
Operational excellence first, analytical strength close behind. You think in systems and from first principles, you're rigorous with data, and you default to execution.
Leadership gravitas without the title. You can walk into a team that's mid-change and organize the chaos. People follow because of how you show up, not your box on the org chart.
Genuine marketing domain expertise. You've operated close to marketing and understand how the pieces fit — design, brand, and measurement — well enough to make the right calls fast.
Comfort in ambiguity and matrixed environments. You navigate dependencies across teams that don't report to you — and still ship.
High throughput and succinct communication. You move a lot of work, and you can show up in any room and communicate clearly and persuasively.
Extreme accountability, low ego. Self-reliant. Resourceful. Solve it yourself first. Do what you said, when you said it.



Bonus


Time in the office of a CMO, a marketing operations seat, or an equivalent operator role close to a marketing leadership team.
Experience in a heavily matrixed organization or a strong growth marketing environment.
Track record of being "parachuted in" successfully — turnarounds, integration leads, or standing up ops for a new bet.



About Shopify

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.

This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.

description:
About the job

About Friendzy

Friendzy is a recruiting platform that automates hiring from outreach to retention, using AI agents to streamline tracking, scheduling, and screening. Our agents integrate directly with Indeed, LinkedIn, Salesforce, ADP, and the other systems our clients already use. Companies using Friendzy have made 40,000+ hires. We serve sales and field organizations across HVAC, solar, roofing, pest control, insurance, windows, home services, transportation, MCA, and EPC, alongside enterprise, private equity, and founder-led teams.




POSITION OVERVIEW

We are hiring remote Candidate Screeners to qualify candidates by phone for our client campaigns. You will work leads we provide, using our dialer and approved scripts, run live qualification calls, and stay on the line while each qualified candidate completes the client's application, so the confirmation is in hand before the call ends.




This is a high-volume, phone-first role. You will speak with candidates all day. The screeners who do well here are consistent, organized, and comfortable holding the same standard call after call.

Fully remote.




A TYPICAL DAY

You'll work a full day on the phone: 180 to 200 dials, 40 to 55 real conversations, and 10 to 12 candidates you personally walk through the client's application and confirm before the call ends. Every one of those confirmations is $7 on top of your retainer. Leads, dialer, and script are all provided, so your only job is the conversation.




SCHEDULE

We have two openings:

Weekday: Monday through Friday, 9am to 5pm Eastern Time
Weekend-inclusive: Wednesday through Sunday, 9am to 5pm Eastern Time. Saturday and Sunday are required.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Conduct live phone qualification calls with candidates using company-provided leads, dialer, and scripts

• Screen against campaign-specific requirements, including experience thresholds, licensing, work history, and any disqualifying criteria

• Ask every required screening question clearly and record the candidate's exact answers • Flag uncertain or borderline responses for review rather than resolving them yourself

• Stay on the line while qualified candidates complete the client's application, and record the confirmation number before ending the call

• Document each call fully: date, time, responses, and disposition

• Honor opt-out, do-not-call, and wrong-number requests immediately and report them the same business day

• Maintain accurate records of call attempts, screening responses, and confirmation status

• Tell your lead when a script question or screening criterion isn't working in practice




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Fluent, clear spoken and written English with a neutral phone presence

• 1+ years in phone-based recruiting, candidate screening, call center work, sales development, or comparable high-volume calling

• Available for the full schedule of the opening you're applying for

• Able to follow a script precisely while noticing when an answer needs a flag

• Comfortable with dialers, CRM or ATS tools, and spreadsheets; quick to learn new systems

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, working computer, and a quality headset




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience screening for transportation, CDL, field sales, or trades roles

• Experience walking candidates through applications or forms by phone

• Prior experience with Auto Dialing System

• Background in a remote or distributed contractor role

• Familiarity with recruiting compliance and consent requirements




TOOLS YOU'LL USE

PhoneBurner for both dialing and CRM, plus Slack. If you haven't used it before, we'll train you on it.




COMPENSATION

• Monthly Retainer: $1,000 USD, paid for each month you meet the minimum output standard below. Prorated for a partial first or final month.

• Per confirmed candidate: $7 each, uncapped

• Daily target: 10 to 12 confirmed candidates

• Realistic monthly earnings at target: $2,470 to $2,764, retainer included

• Payment: Last day of each month via Wise. If that date falls on a weekend, payment is processed the following business day. Candidates confirmed through the 25th are paid that month; later confirmations roll to the following month.

• Independent contractor engagement, non-exclusive




HOW PAY WORKS

• Interested: the candidate says yes on the phone. Not paid.

• Submitted: the application is completed. Not paid.

• Confirmed: a confirmation number is issued and logged. Paid $7.




Pay is earned only at confirmed. Duplicates and candidates whose answers can't be verified are not compensable.




PERFORMANCE STANDARD

We maintain a minimum output standard of 8 confirmed candidates per day on average, measured monthly. Your first month, the standard is 6. The engagement continues while that standard is met.




ONBOARDING

Three days of onboarding: learning the scripts, getting set up in PhoneBurner, and listening to live calls before you take your own. Onboarding days are paid with your first full month once you've completed 30 days on the team.




WHAT WE OFFER

• Fully remote

• Company-provided leads, dialer, scripts, and systems. No sourcing on your own

• Uncapped earnings that scale with your output

• Hands-on experience with a modern AI recruiting stack

• A team that measures results, not hours logged

• A clear path to lead screener and campaign lead roles as the team grows

description:
About the job

Paystand is the world's leading blockchain-enabled B2B payments network, transforming commercial finance into a software-driven, zero-fee, and open ecosystem. Recognized as a CNBC/Statista 2026 World's Top Fintech company, Paystand delivers over a decade of on-chain payments experience to middle and large enterprises.

Paystand's network services more than one million payors that have moved $20+ billion in volume. With its acquisitions of Yaydoo, Teampay and Bitwage, Paystand's full-stack platform includes agentic AI, its USDb stablecoin, and AR/AP solutions on one tightly integrated network. Its non-profit arm, Paystand.org, advances the mission to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain technology.

What We Do

We built the financial system we always thought should exist: zero fees, zero friction, just your money, faster. Blockchain automates receivables and payables, cuts time-to-cash, and turns every transaction into revenue instead of cost.

Why We Do It

The current system takes a cut from the people who build, create, and grow — and calls it the cost of doing business. We don't buy that. Every fee we eliminate compounds into growth. We're here to decentralize finance and hand the power back to the businesses driving the real economy — extended further through Paystand.org's work to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain.

How We Do It

We don't wait for permission or for the industry to catch up — we build the future of finance ourselves, on-chain, in the open. Small moves now, monumental results later.

Join Us

We're not looking for people who want a job in fintech. We're looking for people who want to build what comes after it. Paystand is where you help lead a financial revolution instead of just reading about one. We stand on change. Come stand with us.

Role Overview

As a Senior Product Manager, you will be the engine behind Paystand's B2B payments platform. This is an operator-focused role designed for a builder who thrives on shipping high-quality code and features. You will own the full product development lifecycle, ensuring that our core payment infrastructure is not only robust but consistently evolving to address the specific needs of the LATAM B2B payment market, including navigating regional financial complexities and local market requirements. You will bridge the gap between technical complexity and user value, unblocking engineering squads, managing tight release cycles, and directly driving the velocity of our product roadmap.

Key Responsibilities


End-to-End Execution: Own the product backlog, user stories, and requirements. You are responsible for taking features from initial concept to deployment, ensuring that what gets built matches the business requirement and technical specs.
Product Velocity: Drive the day-to-day operations of your product area. Lead sprint planning, unblock engineering teams, and make the daily trade-off decisions necessary to keep features on track and on time.
Technical Partnership: Work daily with Engineering and Design to translate complex financial/ERP requirements into clear, buildable tasks. Act as the primary technical point of contact to ensure architectural integrity and system performance.
Operational Excellence: Define and monitor success metrics (e.g., release quality, cycle time, adoption rates) and lead the post-launch analysis to iterate and improve features immediately.
Backlog Management: Maintain a high-quality, prioritized backlog. Proactively identify dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure the team is always focused on the most impactful work.
LATAM Product Leadership: Own the LATAM product roadmap, leading product discovery and delivery efforts tailored to the regional ecosystem, including core LATAM products such as Yaydoo and PorCobrar.


What We Are Looking For


5+ years of Product Management experience: Specifically in B2B SaaS, fintech, or complex platform environments.
Operator Mindset: You are a "Builder." You prefer working in the weeds with engineers to solve technical blockers over high-level conceptual planning.
Technical Fluency: You are comfortable working with APIs, data schemas, and cloud-native architectures. You don’t need to write the code, but you must be able to hold your own in technical debates with engineers.
Execution Track Record: A proven history of shipping complex features in high-velocity environments. You can point to products you’ve built and how you managed the development lifecycle to get them live.
Systems Thinking: The ability to decompose complex financial workflows (AR/AP, Reconciliation, ERP integration) into manageable, shippable components.
LATAM Regulatory & Financial Expertise: Deep experience with Mexican/LATAM financial regulations, billing ecosystems (e.g., CFDI/SAT in Mexico, DIAN in Colombia), and local fintech or ERP landscapes.


Nice to Have


Direct experience with ERP ecosystems (NetSuite).
Experience in the payments or financial infrastructure space, including LATAM payment rails like SPEI.
Experience driving product-led growth (PLG) initiatives in B2B.


Why Paystand


Paystand is on a mission to reinvent commercial finance and bring B2B payments into the digital age.
You will join a team focused on product innovation, customer success, and disrupting outdated financial systems.
You will work with forward-thinking finance teams to build modern payment infrastructure.
You will help build the next version of Paystand: a high-ownership organization where your ability to execute has a direct, measurable impact on global B2B commerce.


Perks & Benefits


Enjoy generous PTO and sick leave, because we believe in balance.
Fuel your days with free snacks and paid lunches in the office.
We've got your health covered with Major Medical Health Insurance.
Stay nourished with food vouchers and plan for your future with savings funds.
Unlock stock options and own a piece of our success!
Work with the best tools and equipment, setting you up to thrive.
And the best part? Endless growth opportunities await you as we rapidly expand!


If you're passionate about driving change in the FinTech landscape and being part of a company that is shaping the future of digital payments, we invite you to explore opportunities with Paystand.

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience manifests in diverse ways, skills are transferable, and passion is a powerful driver. Your journey and skills are unique, and we value the richness that diverse perspectives bring to our team.

More than a resume, we prioritize a genuine commitment, impactful contributions, and the ability to thrive in our dynamic, collaborative environment. We are enthusiastic about providing you with opportunities to learn and grow within this role. If your experience aligns closely with what we're seeking, we encourage you to apply.

We celebrate the belief that diversity in backgrounds and thoughts fuels better problem-solving and fosters more creative thinking. Our commitment to adding new perspectives to the team reflects our dedication to innovation and inclusivity.

Your journey is important to us, and we look forward to the possibility of welcoming you to our team at Paystand. Feel free to reach out; we can't wait to hear from you.

Most of our roles are onsite. Positions that are eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements will be clearly indicated in the job posting.

For roles based in Mexico, only resumes submitted in English will be considered.

title: AI & Transformation Manager, Customer Success
skills: Modelo operativo: mapear el ciclo de vida del doctor y decidir, journey por journey, qué resuelve la IA en primera instancia y qué escala a una persona.
Rediseño de journeys: reconstruir onboarding, farming, upsell y churn alrededor de agentes, con puntos de intervención humana definidos de forma explícita.
Mejora continua: el modelo nunca está terminado — actualizarlo conforme cambian producto, herramientas y mercado, y retirar lo que deja de servir.
Causas raíz de churn: atacar falla de pago, onboarding fallido y flujos de churn rotos rediseñando el journey, usando la señal que el negocio ya produce.
Construcción real: prototipar con LLM APIs, frameworks de agentes y workflows, automatización low-code y SQL. Probar valor en alcance acotado antes de pedir inversión de plataforma.
Kraken: evolucionar el outreach automatizado de recordatorios por reglas a agentes capaces de sostener una conversación y resolver la tarea sin escalar a una persona.
Instrumentación: definir qué significa éxito en cada campaña automatizada y cerrar la brecha de conversaciones sin evaluación de resultado.
Escalamiento: llevar los prototipos a sistemas soportados junto con Producto, Tech, Revenue Operations y equipos globales.
Build vs. buy: evaluar proveedores cuando comprar gana a construir, y decirlo con claridad cuando no.
Adopción real: responder por el uso diario de las herramientas por parte de CS, el equipo de upsell y los Key Account Managers — no por los lanzamientos.
Governance de IA: definir qué puede decidir un modelo solo, qué debe escuchar un doctor de una persona, y bajo qué criterios se construye, compra o mata una iniciativa.
Privacidad de datos: garantizar que ningún dato personal o clínico entre a prompts, logs o sistemas de terceros sin base legal y revisión documentada.
Liderazgo: dirigir y hacer crecer a tu equipo; presentar resultados, hipótesis y apuestas fallidas a leadership local y de grupo en números claros.
Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en operaciones comerciales, Customer Success, Service Operations o Revenue Operations, en un negocio de suscripción o marketplace.
Al menos 2 años liderando equipo directo.
Experiencia comprobable construyendo con IA —no solo usándola—: LLM APIs, frameworks de agentes o workflows, diseño de prompts y de evaluación, con sistemas en producción e impacto medible.
Inglés Avanzado
Capacidad de leer un P&L y defender una línea de presupuesto ante Finanzas.
Experiencia gestionando proyectos multifuncionales con stakeholders más senior, sin autoridad formal sobre ellos.
Deseable: experiencia en SaaS, marketplace o salud.
description:
About the job

Descripción de la empresa

En Doctoralia, nuestra misión es humanizar la experiencia de la salud a través de la tecnología. Como la plataforma líder en el mercado mexicano y referente global en soluciones SaaS para el sector médico, conectamos a millones de pacientes con especialistas, transformando la práctica clínica en una experiencia digital eficiente y centrada en el paciente.

La misión

El/la AI & Transformation Manager es dueño del modelo operativo de Customer Success en Doctoralia México: define cómo se atiende al doctor a lo largo de su ciclo de vida —activación, adopción, farming, upsell y churn— y decide, journey por journey, qué resuelve un agente automatizado, qué se queda en manos de una persona y por qué.

Su razón de ser es cambiar la relación entre el tamaño de la cartera y el tamaño del equipo: que atender a más doctores deje de exigir proporcionalmente más gente, sin degradar la calidad de la relación con el doctor. Responde por el resultado en retención y en costo de servir, no por la cantidad de herramientas lanzadas.

Su marco de actuación es la operación de CS México y los sistemas que la ejecutan. Colabora con Producto, Tech, Revenue Operations, el equipo de venta de productos adicionales, los Key Account Managers y los equipos globales del grupo. No es un rol de ciencia de datos: no entrena modelos, construye y opera los sistemas con los que trabaja el área.

Lo que harás


Modelo operativo: mapear el ciclo de vida del doctor y decidir, journey por journey, qué resuelve la IA en primera instancia y qué escala a una persona.
Rediseño de journeys: reconstruir onboarding, farming, upsell y churn alrededor de agentes, con puntos de intervención humana definidos de forma explícita.
Mejora continua: el modelo nunca está terminado — actualizarlo conforme cambian producto, herramientas y mercado, y retirar lo que deja de servir.
Causas raíz de churn: atacar falla de pago, onboarding fallido y flujos de churn rotos rediseñando el journey, usando la señal que el negocio ya produce.
Construcción real: prototipar con LLM APIs, frameworks de agentes y workflows, automatización low-code y SQL. Probar valor en alcance acotado antes de pedir inversión de plataforma.
Kraken: evolucionar el outreach automatizado de recordatorios por reglas a agentes capaces de sostener una conversación y resolver la tarea sin escalar a una persona.
Instrumentación: definir qué significa éxito en cada campaña automatizada y cerrar la brecha de conversaciones sin evaluación de resultado.
Escalamiento: llevar los prototipos a sistemas soportados junto con Producto, Tech, Revenue Operations y equipos globales.
Build vs. buy: evaluar proveedores cuando comprar gana a construir, y decirlo con claridad cuando no.
Adopción real: responder por el uso diario de las herramientas por parte de CS, el equipo de upsell y los Key Account Managers — no por los lanzamientos.
Governance de IA: definir qué puede decidir un modelo solo, qué debe escuchar un doctor de una persona, y bajo qué criterios se construye, compra o mata una iniciativa.
Privacidad de datos: garantizar que ningún dato personal o clínico entre a prompts, logs o sistemas de terceros sin base legal y revisión documentada.
Liderazgo: dirigir y hacer crecer a tu equipo; presentar resultados, hipótesis y apuestas fallidas a leadership local y de grupo en números claros.


Lo que buscamos


Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en operaciones comerciales, Customer Success, Service Operations o Revenue Operations, en un negocio de suscripción o marketplace.
Al menos 2 años liderando equipo directo.
Experiencia comprobable construyendo con IA —no solo usándola—: LLM APIs, frameworks de agentes o workflows, diseño de prompts y de evaluación, con sistemas en producción e impacto medible.
Inglés Avanzado
Capacidad de leer un P&L y defender una línea de presupuesto ante Finanzas.
Experiencia gestionando proyectos multifuncionales con stakeholders más senior, sin autoridad formal sobre ellos.
Deseable: experiencia en SaaS, marketplace o salud.

Recordings should focus on continuous movement, changing scenery, and natural navigation through the environment.




Camera Requirements




You must already own or have access to a compatible camera with:

Compatible camera examples include:

Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.

About the job

This position is based on-site in Mexico City, CDMX. Remote work is not available.

Submitted resumes must be in English to be considered.

About Landing

We are a nationwide hospitality platform where fully-furnished apartments meet hotel quality and consistency. Guests access a curated selection of thousands of high-quality apartments available for any length of stay in hundreds of cities nationwide.

By blending the best of hospitality and everyday comfort, every unit is designed with all the amenities of home, backed by 24/7 local support. For a week-long getaway or an extended adventure, we deliver a familiar and frictionless guest experience that's perfect for any travel occasion, for work or pleasure.

For property owners, we offer a fast path to new revenue and higher occupancy in just weeks by tapping into our nationwide demand for furnished, hospitality-grade housing. We provide a turnkey solution that covers the entire unit experience, from furnishings to guest turnover and everything in between, with zero operational lift from partners. We handle it all so partners can unlock value faster.

About The Role

Short stays are one of the biggest levers we have on occupancy, and every apartment that takes a stay under 30 nights needs a permit, a license, or a confirmed exemption first. Your job is to get those approvals done and get the apartments on sale.

This is a closing job, not a research job. Cities go quiet, property managers miss deadlines, and applications stall for weeks if nobody pushes. You are the person who pushes. The job is measured on one thing: apartments switched on for short-term stays each week.

What You'll Own


File: Prepare and submit business-license, short-term-rental, and tax-registration applications, including city-specific forms, floor plans, and house rules
Chase: Call and email U.S. city and county offices until the permit is issued. Nothing sits without a next action and a date
Switch units on: The day a permit is approved, update the apartment status in our internal system so the units go live
Own renewals: File before expiration. Stop renewals on properties we no longer operate
Escalate: When a partner, a city, or an internal team is blocking units, say so loudly and early. We would rather hear it than lose the month
Build the jurisdiction library: Record each city's rules once so we never research the same market twice

title: Service Pusher II
skills: Job Description
Partner with the best

Baker Hughes es una empresa global de tecnología energética que presta servicios al sector del petróleo y el gas en más de 120 países. La organización Comercial y de Ventas impulsa el crecimiento mediante la creación de sólidas alianzas con los clientes, la comercialización de hidrocarburos y la oferta de soluciones integradas de equipos y servicios. Centrándose en la transformación digital y la transición energética, el equipo aprovecha los conocimientos basados en datos para optimizar el rendimiento de las ventas y maximizar el valor para el cliente.
Fuel your passion

El responsable del servicio de soluciones integradas dirige y coordina todo el trabajo de Baker Hughes en el pozo. Es el punto de contacto de Baker Hughes para el cliente y dirige todos los elementos de los productos, servicios y contratistas de Baker Hughes en el pozo. El objetivo principal es impulsar y garantizar un desempeño impecable en materia de salud, seguridad y medio ambiente, la entrega puntual y la excelencia constante en la prestación de servicios.
Job Description
Responsabilidades esenciales:

Dirige las operaciones integradas de Baker Hughes en la plataforma en estrecha colaboración con el operador, el contratista de la plataforma y cualquier otro tercero. Supervisa las operaciones de acuerdo con el programa de actividad del pozo.

Coordina y asesora a todo el personal de Baker Hughes en las actividades de HSE de la plataforma, la planificación operativa y la ejecución del trabajo. Primera línea de apoyo y referencia técnica para el personal de Baker Hughes en alta mar que realiza las tareas en el pozo.
Garantiza que el proyecto se ejecute de forma segura, conforme a la normativa y eficiente.
Punto de contacto de Baker Hughes para el cliente en el pozo. Participa en revisiones de operaciones, reuniones de seguridad y operaciones matutinas, etc.
Proporciona entradas puntuales en el Centro de Trabajo para las actividades de Soluciones Integradas y aportaciones oportunas a los informes DBR, la evaluación de KPI y los planes de mejora.
Responsable de la demanda, planificación y coordinación del personal offshore/onshore (cuando corresponda).
Optimiza la utilización de los recursos humanos offshore/onshore (cuando corresponda) de Baker Hughes.
Utiliza el centro de operaciones remotas de manera eficiente durante las operaciones (si corresponde).
Dirige las investigaciones de fallas en los equipos offshore de Baker Hughes, las reporta y las comunica según corresponda.
Garantiza que se recopilen y apliquen las lecciones aprendidas y las mejores prácticas.
Cualificaciones/Requisitos:
Licenciatura en un campo relevante. Una amplia experiencia puede compensar la falta de educación formal.
Más de 8 años de experiencia relevante en la industria del petróleo y el gas.
Experiencia como jefe de equipo.
Conocimientos exhaustivos sobre operaciones de servicio de campo, instalación y mantenimiento.
Competencia para planificar, resolver problemas, organizar, dirigir y controlar operaciones complejas.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación.
Buenas habilidades organizativas.
Manejo del inglés escrito y oral como idioma de trabajo.
Promoción de una cultura de colaboración y trabajo en equipo entre múltiples líneas de productos, funciones, geografías y partes externas.
Características/habilidades deseadas:
Gran capacidad de liderazgo situacional.
Buenas habilidades informáticas.
Buenas habilidades de presentación.
Estructurado.
Trabajar con nosotros

Nuestra gente es el centro de todo lo que hacemos en Baker Hughes. Sabemos que somos mejores cuando todos nuestros empleados se desarrollan, se comprometen y pueden aportar todo su potencial al trabajo. Invertimos en la salud y el bienestar de nuestra fuerza laboral, capacitamos y recompensamos el talento y desarrollamos líderes en todos los niveles para sacar lo mejor de cada uno.
Trabajando para usted

Nuestros inventos han revolucionado la energía durante más de un siglo. Pero para seguir avanzando en el futuro, sabemos que tenemos que superar los límites hoy. Damos prioridad a recompensar a aquellos que aceptan el cambio con un paquete que refleja lo mucho que valoramos su aportación.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

About our client

Our client manufactures premium powder-coated garage door hardware sold through dealers and distributors across the continental US. Our flagship line and patent-pending are sold B2B through an authorized dealer program and distribution partnerships. Marketing here directly drives dealer acquisition, distributor partnerships, and reorder revenue.




About the Role 

You will own marketing execution across two lanes: always-on brand and social content, and structured launch campaigns for product releases and distribution partnerships. Recent example of the second lane: a multi-week partner launch coordinated across two companies, covering teaser and announcement social sequences, a trade press release, a segmented three-email campaign, dealer and rep enablement collateral, and post-launch lead capture into our CRM. You will build the plan, track every asset, hit the gates, and report on results.




This is an AI-forward role. We expect you to use AI as a force multiplier across everything you do here: drafting and refining copy, generating and iterating imagery, building campaign plans, analyzing performance, and automating the repetitive parts of your own workflow. If you are a 9 out of 10 on putting AI to work in marketing, you will thrive here. If you are still writing everything from a blank page and waiting on a designer for every graphic, this is not the right fit.




What You'll Do 

Campaign management

• Build and run integrated launch campaigns for product releases and partner announcements: phased timelines, asset trackers, dependencies, and launch gates

• Write and sequence campaign content end to end: teaser posts, announcement posts, press releases, and multi-touch email campaigns with segmentation (launch, non-opener resend, engaged follow-up, nurture)

• Coordinate deliverables across THP, partner marketing teams, and outside creative, keeping owners, statuses, and due dates current in a shared tracker

• Produce dealer and rep enablement collateral for launches: sell sheets, FAQs, pricing cards, order guides, talk tracks

• Set up campaign tracking: UTM conventions, attribution plans, and lead imports into Zoho CRM so campaign results are measurable

Ongoing brand and social

• Plan, write, and schedule weekly LinkedIn and Meta content in THP's brand voice, targeted at garage door dealers, installers, and distributors

About the job

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we're a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We're hiring a Marketing Production Support Lead for a leading on-demand consumer marketplace that reaches millions of customers — leading a team of QA specialists across email, push, in-app, and promo campaigns, and acting as the escalation point for CRM campaign execution and quality.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Team Leadership: Host daily stand-ups to manage team workload and re-assign tickets as needed.
Campaign Accountability: Own the preparation and execution of CRM campaign tactics by a team of GAs — promotions, in-app banners, emails, and customer lists.
QA Oversight: Support and internally QA a team conducting quality assurance across all email marketing deliverables (templates, popups, campaigns, flows, and SMS), checking technical setups before launch for strategy alignment, deliverability, and targeting.

Quality Tracking: Flag SLA violations and QA misses to leadership, record areas where operators frequently miss, and consolidate and track QA misses to identify frequent problem areas.
Strategic Review: Review campaigns from a strategic perspective and provide guidance, and respond to operators promptly via Slack, email, and Jira tickets.
Reporting: Report on self-serve processes monthly, quarterly, and annually, and triage errors and expedited requests across email, push, in-app, and promo.
Training & Auditing: Create and improve training material for new operators alongside the manager, and conduct random audit QA cases to ensure ongoing quality.




What You Bring

CRM QA Experience: 3+ years of experience in QA-specific tasks for CRM (Braze preferred, but not mandatory).
ESP Experience: 3+ years of experience with an ESP (email service provider) platform.
Leadership: 2+ years in a leadership role with a clear ability to hit KPIs while fostering a motivating work environment.
Tools: Proficiency with Jira, Slack, Google Suite, and CRM systems (email, push, in-app, promo codes); intermediate HTML and SQL; intermediate Google Sheets.
Campaign & Budget Experience: Experience reviewing, updating, and scheduling digital campaigns (copy, code, creative review) and managing promo budgets to meet business goals.
Attention to Detail: Exceptionally high attention to detail — thorough, consistent double-checking, and a strong focus on following guidelines and testing everything works properly.
Communication: Highly proficient written and spoken English, with extremely clear communication and direction to team members.

You have experience in the tech industry.
You have experience working with an app-centric client.




What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren't just joining a company; you're joining a movement to redefine how the world's best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything — and that starts with how we take care of you.




We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package:

Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again
Health Coverage: HMO or Healthcare Stipend (depending on location) after 90 days of service
Time to Recharge: 7 Paid Holidays and up to 6 PTO days per year
Family First: Parental leave after 1 year of service

$25 monthly perfect attendance bonus
Performance bonus
Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years)
Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client

You've applied, now let's get to work. Here's the play-by-play:

Step 5 15-min Prep Call: We've got your back. Before the final round, your Recruiter will hop on a quick call to coach you, share insider tips, and ensure you're 100% ready.

This role follows a rotating shift pattern, including evenings and weekends, depending on live events.




ABOUT US 




Storyteller is a high growth B2B SaaS platform, which allows companies to integrate Stories into their owned and operated platforms. Popularized by Instagram and Snapchat, Stories are perfectly suited for boosting user engagement, audience retention, and driving advertising revenue.

title: Encargado de redes sociales
description:
About the job

Mánager de Contenido y Redes — SoyIvanInversor (remoto, tiempo completo)

Invedx con SoyIvanInversor como principal canal de distribución de Ivan Prats sobre cripto, mercados e inversión, en español.

El formato principal son directos de mercado varias veces por semana. De cada directo sale todo lo demás: clips, hilos, posts, comunidad.

RESPONSABILIDADES

Convertir cada directo en crecimiento.

Después de cada emisión:

- Eliges los 5–8 momentos que de verdad paran el scroll y escribes el hook y el copy de cada uno.

- Recortas, editas y publicas desde las cuentas del canal en YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels y X, a ritmo de 2–3 clips al día. Los clips de un directo salen en menos de 24 horas: en cripto, lo de hoy caduca mañana.

- Escribes el hilo de X de cada directo y publicas avisos de cada transmisión.

- Respondes comentarios en la primera hora, limpias spam e impostores y clasificas los DMs.

- Cada viernes entregas un reporte simple: clip, plataforma, views, retención, seguidores ganados, highlights de la comunidad (comentarios) y propones dos cambios para la semana siguiente.

Tu objetivo no es publicar clips, sino analizar rendimiento y buscar crecimiento, publicar sin resultados no sirve.

REQUISITOS

- Experiencia manejando redes sociales con enfoque a crecimiento.

- Experiencia editando (ya sea con programas como Premiere y After effects, o con IA).

- Entiendes cripto y mercados lo suficiente para saber qué momento de un directo importa hoy y cuál no importará mañana.

- Sabes leer e interpretar datos de las plataformas sociales; retención, CTR, seguidores por clip, y propones adaptaciones en base a los datos.

- Autonomía real en remoto, no esperas a que te digan qué hacer, eres proactivo/a.

CONDICIONES

- Tiempo completo, 100 % remoto (Latam o España), contrato como freelance/autónomo.

- Base de USD 1.500–2.500 al mes según lo que demuestres, más bono por resultados de crecimiento.

About the job

Who We Are

A Christian behavioral health organization with clinics in Florida and Cozumel, Mexico is looking for a digital PR and outreach specialist to build our authority through earned media, professional listings, and expert placements.

You will work directly with our founder, a PsyD who has founded three behavioral health organizations, is a published author with his own publishing imprint, and has appeared on Christian television. You will also work with our staff psychiatrist, a board certified MD with peer reviewed publications. Your job is to turn those credentials into third party coverage, citations, and links.

This is earned media work. We do not buy links or placements, and candidates who propose that will not be considered. We evaluate you on real conversations you open and coverage you earn, not on volume of email sent.




What you will do

Research and build target lists of credible outlets, then find and verify the right editor, producer, or contact at each
Draft personalized pitches for our founder's approval and signature. Every pitch is specific to one outlet and one person. No templates.
Send approved pitches, manage replies, and run intelligent, human follow-ups that move contacts toward a real conversation
Manage our podcast guest pipeline, including an existing paid PodMatch professional membership capable of eight to twelve pitches per week that is currently underused
Submit, complete, and verify professional association and directory listings
Find existing mentions of our people and organizations that carry no link, and work to convert them into links or upgraded citations
Build ongoing relationships with editors, producers, and journalists so we become a repeat source
Track every target, pitch, response, follow-up, and placement in Airtable
Report weekly on both activity and outcomes, using the KPIs below




What we are looking for

Two or more years in digital PR, earned media, outreach, or link acquisition
Strong written English. You will be drafting copy that goes out under a doctor's name.
Demonstrated placements you personally earned, with links. We will look at them.
Comfort with research and rejection. Most pitches are ignored. That is normal and not a measure of your work.
Organized enough to run a pipeline in Airtable without being chased
Able to work with a team on US Central time for some overlap

Helpful but not required: familiarity with healthcare, behavioral health, or any regulated industry. Familiarity with Christian media or faith based audiences. Experience with AI search visibility, sometimes called GEO or AEO. Experience with academic or research citations.

Automatic disqualifiers: proposing to buy links, guest posts, or placements. Private blog networks. Guaranteed placement volume. AI generated pitches sent at scale.




How we measure the role

We split KPIs into two groups on purpose. Leading indicators show whether the machine is running. Outcomes show whether the work is landing. Reporting either one alone does not tell us the role is working. "I sent 200 emails" is not a result.




Leading indicators, reported weekly:
